# Get set of current venmo friend emails
current_friend_emails = {f['email'] for f in all_friends}

# Identify contacts not yet friends
to_add = []
for contact in all_contacts:
    email = contact.get('email')
    if email and email not in current_friend_emails:
        to_add.append((contact['first_name'], contact['last_name'], email))
    elif not email:
        print(f"Contact {contact['first_name']} {contact['last_name']} has no email, skipping")

print("Contacts to add:", to_add)

# Verify all contacts are now friends
venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']
all_friends_updated = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    friends_page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not friends_page:
        break
    all_friends_updated.extend(friends_page)
    if len(friends_page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

updated_friend_emails = {f['email'] for f in all_friends_updated}
print("Updated friend count:", len(all_friends_updated))
print("Updated friend emails:", updated_friend_emails)

# Check all contact emails are in updated list
all_contact_emails = {c.get('email') for c in all_contacts if c.get('email')}
missing = all_contact_emails - updated_friend_emails
print("Missing contacts:", missing if missing else "None - all contacts are friends")
